preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array a must be between 2 and 200,000.
The constant m must be at least 1 and at most n divided by k.
The number of subarrays k must be at least 2 and at most n divided by m.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum possible sum of beauties followed by the partition indices.
The partition must contain exactly k-1 indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < n for p_i in partition)
postconditions.description: Each partition index must be within the valid range of the array indices.
